name: StarPromptDialog
description: One-time nudge asking a repeat user to star the project on GitHub.
notes: Figma is not linked yet. Bespoke night-sky illustration (scoped <style>): a seeded mulberry32 PRNG scatters the twinkling stars and the shooting-star streaks, so the sky looks random but is identical on every render and in story snapshots. Anatomy is two columns over the sky: copy on the left (title and paragraph), the 'Star on GitHub' button vertically centred in the right column with 'Maybe later' hanging beneath it, plus a close X pinned top right. The illustration uses raw decorative colours rather than design tokens and the surface is intentionally dark regardless of theme; the action buttons' colour treatment (muted 'Maybe later' text, primary button glow) is part of the same exception and lives in the scoped style block under stable class names. Streaks are driven by per-element CSS custom properties (--x, --y, --angle, --len, --dist, --dur, --delay); they all share one fall angle and are brief flashes that fade while still travelling, on a cycle sixteen times their visible duration so there are real gaps between them. Under prefers-reduced-motion the streaks are dropped and the twinkles hold at a static mid brightness. Auto-opens from app state (launch count, seen flag) via bindings, gated behind the What's New dialog; renders closed in Storybook where those stores are inert.
